verdict.rationale: A managed agent runtime or orchestration service is a fair question for a major cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party agent hosting or orchestration service. The only AI-adjacent items are an official MCP server probe and Azure Copilot generating Terraform, which are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents have a managed home — first-party agent runtimes/orchestration services shipped and documented, not just a blog vision
